conf.description: ServiceNow audit (sys_audit), kafka-json via LES Kafka topic: JSON extract + ECS/custom field mapping, direct route.

conf.comment: ServiceNow audit (sys_audit) via LES Kafka topic, kafka-json. Direct route per recommendations.direct.cribl: thin JSON reshape into servicenow.event.* shape; oldvalue/newvalue redaction is a guarded-path-only requirement and is NOT implemented here (see README gap). sys_id dedup left to the consumer/destination, not implemented in-pipeline (see README gap).

functions.description: LES wraps sys_audit rows in a JSON envelope; extract the inner row's fields from _raw
sys_created_by is the change actor's name; LES emits the raw sys_user reference (sys_id) with no display_value pair, so it is the stable identity on user.id

map the audit discriminator columns to servicenow.audit.*, derive event.action from the DELETED/RECOVERED sentinels, set _time from the Glide sys_created_on (assumes the instance renders this column in UTC), tag event.dataset, and drop the now-duplicated raw columns
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
